lines.text: In Colombia, one man would build an empire that shook the world.
From humble beginnings, he rose to become the leader of the Medellín Cartel.
He even entered politics, but his empire was built on more than money.
It was built on violence, corruption, and fear.
After surrendering in 1991, he escaped from prison a year later.
Now a fugitive, his empire was collapsing.
On December 2, 1993, Pablo Escobar was killed on a rooftop in Medellín.
His empire was gone. But Colombia would live with its consequences for decades.
